mechanism: Both agents cause CNS depression and cardiovascular effects; guanfacine may potentiate metoprolol's beta-blocking effects leading to additive hypotension and bradycardia, and abrupt discontinuation of either drug can cause rebound hypertension.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; ensure gradual dose tapering if discontinuing either agent; educate patient on orthostatic precautions and report symptoms of excessive hypotension or bradycardia.
